note: Adapted from the species-level description in Ahmad, Termites of Thailand (Bulletin of the American Museum of Natural History, vol. 131), the original in English; the description there is the author's verbatim quotation of his 1963 original description (Ahmad, 1963, pp. 397—399), and the heading in the volume reads Soldier (fig. 57). Only the soldier caste is included; the worker appears only as a citation in the synonymy list (Ahmad, 1963, figs. 2a—h), and its morphology is not repeated in this volume. In the source pack the measurement block is set in two columns and OCR has interleaved the left and right columns into the same line: the first 3 items (head length, left mandible length, distance from the left mandibular tooth to the tip) were read as separate columns, and the remaining 9 items come from continuous lines that were not interleaved; both follow the original "range (mean)" form, with nothing supplied by guesswork. Locality and Remarks follow (a discussion of Eurytermes isodentatus, which should be placed in Indotermes), with no further morphological description.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish brown, the sides slightly darker than the middle; labrum and antennae yellowish brown; mandibles yellowish brown at the base, brown in the toothed region and beyond; thoracic and abdominal tergites brown, with a white longitudinal stripe along the dorsal midline; legs pale. Head capsule densely covered with short hairs and with scattered long bristles; postclypeus with a few hairs; labrum moderately hairy; mandibles with a few microtrichia at the base; pronotum densely pubescent and with several very long bristles; mesonotal and metanotal hairs slightly fewer than on the pronotum; abdominal tergites and sternites densely hairy; legs densely covered with short hairs and with scattered long bristles. Head hypognathous, square, slightly wider anteriorly. Labrum almost as long as wide, ligulate, sides parallel. Mandibles stout; the tip slightly curved inwards; the base swollen, the outer margin raised; the anterior half narrowed; the inner margin with one distinct broad tooth in the middle. Postmentum flat, more than twice as long as wide, widest in the anterior half and narrowest near the posterior end. Antennae long and slender, 14-segmented, segment 2 slightly shorter than segment 3, segment 3 almost as long as segment 4 but shorter than segment 5. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe much longer than the posterior lobe, the anterior margin convex and without any notch, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave. Tarsi 3-segmented. Measurements (2 soldiers, mean in parentheses): head length (measured from the lateral base of the mandibles) 2.18—2.23 mm (2.20), left mandible length 1.19—1.22 mm (1.20), distance from the left mandibular tooth to the tip 0.54—0.57 mm (0.55), right mandible length 1.17—1.19 mm (1.18), distance from the right mandibular tooth to the tip 0.54—0.57 mm (0.55), head width (at the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.71—1.76 mm (1.73), head width at midlength 1.66—1.74 mm (1.70), postmentum length 1.22—1.24 mm (1.23), postmentum maximum width 0.45 mm (0.45), postmentum minimum width 0.23—0.26 mm (0.24), pronotum length 0.59—0.65 mm (0.62), pronotum width 0.83 mm (0.83).
